name: RandomSetTheory.abs_supportFunctionDifference_sub_le

theorem abs_supportFunctionDifference_sub_le {K L : Set E}
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L)

    (hRK : ∀ x ∈ K, ‖x‖ ≤ RK) (hRL : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ RL)
    (u v : E) :
    |(supportFunction K u - supportFunction L u) -
        (supportFunction K v - supportFunction L v)| ≤
      (RK + RL) * ‖u - v‖

statement:
theorem IsIntegrableSelection.exists_lift_caratheodory_image
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set X} {v : Ω → Y}
    {φ : Ω × X → Y}
    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (hφmeas : Measurable φ)
    (hφcont : ∀ ω, Continuous fun x => φ (ω, x))
    {g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω)
    (hv : IsIntegrableSelection μ
      (fun ω => (fun x => φ (ω, x)) '' S ω) v) :
    ∃ f : Ω → X,
      IsIntegrableSelection μ S f ∧
      Integrable (fun ω => φ (ω, f ω)) μ ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, φ (ω, f ω) = v ω

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_caratheodory_image
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_caratheodory_image
    [NormedSpace ℝ Y]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set X} {φ : Ω × X → Y}
    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (hφmeas : Measurable φ)
    (hφcont : ∀ ω, Continuous fun x => φ (ω, x))
    {g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω) :
    aumannExpectation μ
        (fun ω => (fun x => φ (ω, x)) '' S ω) =
      {y | ∃ f : Ω → X,
        IsIntegrableSelection μ S f ∧
        Integrable (fun ω => φ (ω, f ω)) μ ∧
        ∫ ω, φ (ω, f ω) ∂μ = y}

      (∀ omega, q omega = f omega ∨ q omega = g omega) ∧

    let p := minkowskiDecompositionSelection
      hS hT hScompact hTcompact hSne hTne hh ω

      dist (p.1 + p.2) (h ω) = infDist (h ω) (S ω + T ω)

name: ProbabilityTheory.chernoffObjective_add_harmonic_le
statement:
theorem chernoffObjective_add_harmonic_le
    {psi0 psi1 : ℝ → ℝ} {x s t : ℝ}
    (hconv0 : ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) psi0)
    (hconv1 : ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) psi1)
    (hzero0 : psi0 0 = 0) (hzero1 : psi1 0 = 0)
    (hs : 0 < s) (ht : 0 < t) :
    ((psi0 (s * t / (s + t)) + psi1 (s * t / (s + t))) + x) /
        (s * t / (s + t)) ≤
      (psi0 t + x) / t + (psi1 s + x) / s

    (F : Z → Set E) (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z)) (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (hFbound : ∀ z, ∀ x ∈ F z, ‖x‖ ≤ R)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {eps t : ℝ}
    (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (N : Finset E) (hN : ∀ v ∈ N, ‖v‖ ≤ 1)
    (hnet : ∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v ≤ eps) :
    μ.real {ω | t + (R + R) * eps <
        hausdorffDist
          (closedConvexHull ℝ
            (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) (fun i => F (X i ω))))
          (iidAumannTarget μ (X 0) F)} ≤
      N.card * (2 * exp (-(n : ℝ) * t ^ 2 /
        (2 * (R + R) ^ 2)))

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_dimensional_bernstein_confidence
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_dimensional_bernstein_confidence
    {Ω ι E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (v : ι → ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ≥0)
    {RS RL eps δ : ℝ}
    (hScompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hSconv : ∀ i ω, Convex ℝ (S i ω))
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    (hRS : ∀ i ω, ∀ y ∈ S i ω, ‖y‖ ≤ RS)
    (hRL : ∀ y ∈ L, ‖y‖ ≤ RL)
    (heps : 0 < eps) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδone : δ ≤ 1)
    (h_indep : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L w) μ)
    (hB : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ i ∈ s,
      ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF
        (directionalSupportDeviation S L w i) (v i) b μ)
    (hV : 0 < ((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) :
    μ.real {ω |
        (Real.sqrt (2 * ((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) *
              Real.log
                (2 * (1 + 2 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E / δ)) +
            2 * (b : ℝ) *
              Real.log
                (2 * (1 + 2 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E / δ)) /
            (s.card : ℝ) + (RS + RL) * eps <
          hausdorffDist (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) L} ≤ δ

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_dimensional_bernstein_sqrt_add
statement:

    {Ω ι E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (v : ι → ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ≥0)
    {RS RL eps x : ℝ}
    (hScompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hSconv : ∀ i ω, Convex ℝ (S i ω))
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    (hRS : ∀ i ω, ∀ y ∈ S i ω, ‖y‖ ≤ RS)
    (hRL : ∀ y ∈ L, ‖y‖ ≤ RL)
    (heps : 0 < eps) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (h_indep : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L w) μ)
    (hB : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ i ∈ s,
      ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF
        (directionalSupportDeviation S L w i) (v i) b μ)
    (hV : 0 < ((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) :
    μ.real {ω |
        (Real.sqrt (2 * ((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) * x) +
            2 * (b : ℝ) * x) / (s.card : ℝ) + (RS + RL) * eps <
          hausdorffDist (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) L} ≤
      (1 + 2 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E * (2 * exp (-x))

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_dimensional_of_bernstein
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_dimensional_of_bernstein
    {Ω ι E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (v : ι → ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ≥0)
    {RS RL eps t : ℝ}
    (hScompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hSconv : ∀ i ω, Convex ℝ (S i ω))
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    (hRS : ∀ i ω, ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ‖x‖ ≤ RS)
    (hRL : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ RL)
    (heps : 0 < eps) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (h_indep : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L w) μ)
    (hB : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ i ∈ s,
      ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF
        (directionalSupportDeviation S L w i) (v i) b μ)
    (hV : 0 < ((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) :
    μ.real {ω | t + (RS + RL) * eps <
        hausdorffDist (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) L} ≤
      (1 + 2 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E *
        (2 * exp (-((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 /
          (2 * (((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) +
            (b : ℝ) * ((s.card : ℝ) * t)))))

    (b r delta0 : ℝ) (m : ℕ)

statement:

    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (Z : Omega → T → ℝ) (N : ℕ → Finset T)
    (proj : ℕ → T → T) (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (lower upper : ℕ → ℝ)
    (b r lower0 upper0 : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (hproj : ∀ k, k ≤ m → ∀ t, proj k t ∈ N k)
    (hrem : ∀ omega t, |Z omega t - Z omega (proj m t)| ≤ r)
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (ha : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, 0 ≤ a k)
    (hbaseMeas : ∀ u ∈ N 0, AEMeasurable (fun omega ↦ Z omega u) mu)
    (hbaseBounds : ∀ u ∈ N 0,
      ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, Z omega u ∈ Set.Icc lower0 upper0)
    (hbaseCentered : ∀ u ∈ N 0, ∫ omega, Z omega u ∂mu = 0)
    (hincrMeas : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u ∈ N (k + 1),
      ∀ v ∈ N k,
        AEMeasurable (fun omega ↦ Z omega u - Z omega v) mu)
    (hincrBounds : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u ∈ N (k + 1),
      ∀ v ∈ N k, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
        Z omega u - Z omega v ∈ Set.Icc (lower k) (upper k))
    (hincrCentered : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u ∈ N (k + 1),
      ∀ v ∈ N k, ∫ omega, (Z omega u - Z omega v) ∂mu = 0) :
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t,
        b + (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, a k) + r < |Z omega t|} ≤
      (N 0).card *
          (2 * exp (-b ^ 2 / (2 * (hoeffdingMGFProxy lower0 upper0 : ℝ)))) +
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
          ((N (k + 1)).card * (N k).card : ℕ) *
            (2 * exp (-(a k) ^ 2 /
              (2 * (hoeffdingMGFProxy (lower k) (upper k) : ℝ))))

statement:

    (Z : Omega → T → ℝ) (N0 : Finset T)
    (edges : ℕ → Finset (T × T)) (proj : ℕ → T → T)
    (baseVariance baseScale : T → ℝ≥0)
    (edgeVariance edgeScale : ℕ → T → T → ℝ≥0)
    (V B : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (V0 B0 : ℝ≥0)
    (x : ℕ → ℝ) (x0 remainder : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (hbase : ∀ t, proj 0 t ∈ N0)
    (hedge : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ t,
      (proj (k + 1) t, proj k t) ∈ edges k)
    (hrem : ∀ omega t,
      |Z omega t - Z omega (proj m t)| ≤ remainder)
    (hx0 : 0 ≤ x0) (hx : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, 0 ≤ x k)
    (hbaseVariance : ∀ u ∈ N0, 0 < (baseVariance u : ℝ))
    (hedgeVariance : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      0 < (edgeVariance k e.1 e.2 : ℝ))
    (hbaseVariance_le : ∀ u ∈ N0, baseVariance u ≤ V0)
    (hbaseScale_le : ∀ u ∈ N0, baseScale u ≤ B0)
    (hedgeVariance_le : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      edgeVariance k e.1 e.2 ≤ V k)
    (hedgeScale_le : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      edgeScale k e.1 e.2 ≤ B k)
    (hbaseBernstein : ∀ u ∈ N0,
      HasBernsteinMGF (fun omega ↦ Z omega u)
        (baseVariance u) (baseScale u) mu)
    (hedgeBernstein : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      HasBernsteinMGF (fun omega ↦ Z omega e.1 - Z omega e.2)
        (edgeVariance k e.1 e.2) (edgeScale k e.1 e.2) mu) :
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t,
        bernsteinMixedThreshold (V0 : ℝ) (B0 : ℝ) x0 +
            (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
              bernsteinMixedThreshold (V k : ℝ) (B k : ℝ) (x k)) +
            remainder < |Z omega t|} ≤
      N0.card * (2 * exp (-x0)) +
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, (edges k).card * (2 * exp (-x k))

    (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hbaseZero : ∀ omega, ∀ u ∈ N0, Z omega u = 0)
    (hx : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, 0 ≤ x k)
    (hd2pos : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      0 < (d2 e.1 e.2 : ℝ))

    (hedgeBernstein : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u ∈ N (k + 1),
      ∀ v ∈ N k,

          (edgeVariance k u v) (edgeScale k u v) mu) :
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t,
        baseThreshold +
            (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, edgeThreshold k) + remainder <
          |Z omega t|} ≤
      (N 0).card * (2 * exp (-x0)) +
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,

name: ProbabilityTheory.cvarObjective_le_of_exponentialMoment

    [IsFiniteMeasure mu] {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : Integrable X mu)
    {alpha lambda : ℝ} (halpha : 0 ≤ alpha) (hlambda : 0 < lambda)
    (hExp : Integrable (fun omega ↦ Real.exp (lambda * X omega)) mu)
    (t : ℝ) :

        ((Real.exp (-lambda * t - 1) / lambda) *
          ∫ omega, Real.exp (lambda * X omega) ∂mu)

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_dimensional_of_common_moment
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_dimensional_of_common_moment
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    {RS RL eps t M : ℝ}
    (hScompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hSconv : ∀ i ω, Convex ℝ (S i ω))
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    (hRS : ∀ i ω, ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ‖x‖ ≤ RS)
    (hRL : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ RL)
    (heps : 0 < eps) (ht : 0 < t)
    (h_meas : ∀ v : E, ‖v‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ i ∈ s,
      AEMeasurable (directionalSupportDeviation S L v i) μ)
    (h_moment : ∀ v : E, ‖v‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable
      (fun ω => |directionalSupportDeviation S L v i ω| ^ q) μ)
    (h_moment_le : ∀ v : E, ‖v‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ i ∈ s,
      ProbabilityTheory.absoluteMoment
        (directionalSupportDeviation S L v i) q μ ≤ M) :
    μ.real {ω | t + (RS + RL) * eps <
        hausdorffDist (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) L} ≤
      (1 + 2 / eps) ^ Module.finrank ℝ E * (M / t ^ q)

    (hSne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hSconv : ∀ i ω, Convex ℝ (S i ω))
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    (hRS : ∀ i ω, ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ‖x‖ ≤ RS)
    (hRL : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ RL)
    (heps : 0 < eps) (ht : 0 < t)
    (h_meas : ∀ v : E, ‖v‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ i ∈ s,
      AEMeasurable (directionalSupportDeviation S L v i) μ)
    (h_moment : ∀ v : E, ‖v‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable

    (h_moment_le : ∀ v : E, ‖v‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ i ∈ s,
      ProbabilityTheory.absoluteMoment
        (directionalSupportDeviation S L v i) q μ ≤ m i) :
    μ.real {ω | t + (RS + RL) * eps <
        hausdorffDist (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) L} ≤
      (1 + 2 / eps) ^ Module.finrank ℝ E *
        ((∑ i ∈ s, m i) / ((s.card : ℝ) * t ^ q))

statement:

    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty) (v : ι → ℝ)
    {RS RL eps t : ℝ}
    (hScompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))

    (hSconv : ∀ i ω, Convex ℝ (S i ω))
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    (hRS : ∀ i ω, ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ‖x‖ ≤ RS)
    (hRL : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ RL)
    (heps : 0 < eps) (ht : 0 < t)
    (h_indep : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L w) μ)
    (hL2 : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ i ∈ s,
      MemLp (directionalSupportDeviation S L w i) 2 μ)
    (h_centered : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ i ∈ s,
      μ[directionalSupportDeviation S L w i] = 0)
    (h_variance_le : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ i ∈ s,
      ProbabilityTheory.variance
        (directionalSupportDeviation S L w i) μ ≤ v i) :
    μ.real {ω | t + (RS + RL) * eps <
        hausdorffDist (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) L} ≤
      (1 + 2 / eps) ^ Module.finrank ℝ E *
        ((∑ i ∈ s, v i) / (((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ 2))

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_condExp_truncation_le_moment_div
statement:
theorem abs_condExp_truncation_le_moment_div
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] (hm : m ≤ mOmega)
    {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X mu)
    (hcenter : mu[X | m] =ᵐ[mu] 0)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hXq : Integrable (fun omega ↦ |X omega| ^ q) mu)
    {K y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y)
    (hcondMoment : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z ↦ |X z| ^ q | m] omega ≤ K) :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      |mu[truncation X y | m] omega| ≤ K / y ^ (q - 1)

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_finiteProcessSupremum_le
statement:
theorem abs_finiteProcessSupremum_le
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty) (X : T → Omega → ℝ)
    (A : Omega → ℝ)
    (hdom : ∀ omega t, t ∈ s → |X t omega| ≤ |A omega|)
    (omega : Omega) :
    |finiteProcessSupremum s hs X omega| ≤ |A omega|

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_finset_sup'_sub_sup'_le_sup'_abs_sub
statement:
theorem abs_finset_sup'_sub_sup'_le_sup'_abs_sub
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty) (f g : T → ℝ) :
    |s.sup' hs f - s.sup' hs g| ≤
      s.sup' hs (fun t ↦ |f t - g t|)

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_finset_sup'_sum_replace_one_le
statement:
theorem abs_finset_sup'_sum_replace_one_le
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (r : T → ℝ) (X X' : T → ℝ) :
    |s.sup' hs (fun t ↦ r t + X t) -
        s.sup' hs (fun t ↦ r t + X' t)| ≤
      s.sup' hs (fun t ↦ |X t - X' t|)

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_finset_sup'_sum_replace_one_le_add_envelopes
statement:
theorem abs_finset_sup'_sum_replace_one_le_add_envelopes
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (r : T → ℝ) (X X' : T → ℝ) {A A' : ℝ}
    (hX : ∀ t ∈ s, |X t| ≤ A)
    (hX' : ∀ t ∈ s, |X' t| ≤ A') :
    |s.sup' hs (fun t ↦ r t + X t) -
        s.sup' hs (fun t ↦ r t + X' t)| ≤ A + A'

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_sum_martingaleTruncationCenter_le_moment_div
statement:
theorem abs_sum_martingaleTruncationCenter_le_moment_div
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hD : StronglyAdapted filtration D)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hDq : ∀ k < n, Integrable (fun omega ↦ |D k omega| ^ q) mu)
    (hcenter0 : ∫ omega, D 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hcenterSucc : ∀ k < n - 1,
      mu[D (k + 1) | filtration k] =ᵐ[mu] 0)
    (K : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hmoment0 : absoluteMoment (D 0) q mu ≤ K 0)
    (hcondMoment : ∀ k < n - 1, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z ↦ |D (k + 1) z| ^ q | filtration k] omega ≤ K (k + 1))
    {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      |∑ k ∈ range n,
          martingaleTruncationCenter filtration mu D y k omega| ≤
        (∑ k ∈ range n, K k) / y ^ (q - 1)

name: ProbabilityTheory.aemeasurable_conditionallyCenteredTruncation
statement:
theorem aemeasurable_conditionallyCenteredTruncation
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu] {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X mu)
    (hm : m ≤ mOmega) (y : ℝ) :
    AEMeasurable (conditionallyCenteredTruncation mu m X y) mu

name: ProbabilityTheory.centeredTruncation_proxy_coe
statement:
theorem centeredTruncation_proxy_coe (y : ℝ) :
    (((‖(2 * |y|) - (-2 * |y|)‖₊ / 2) ^ 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) =
      4 * y ^ 2

name: ProbabilityTheory.condExp_conditionallyCenteredTruncation_ae_eq_zero
statement:
theorem condExp_conditionallyCenteredTruncation_ae_eq_zero
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] (hm : m ≤ mOmega)
    {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X mu) (y : ℝ) :
    mu[conditionallyCenteredTruncation mu m X y | m] =ᵐ[mu] 0

name: ProbabilityTheory.condExp_doobCenteredDifference_succ_ae_eq_zero
statement:
theorem condExp_doobCenteredDifference_succ_ae_eq_zero
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu] [SigmaFiniteFiltration mu filtration]
    (F : Omega → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    mu[doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F (k + 1) | filtration k]
      =ᵐ[mu] 0

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionallyCenteredTruncation_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem conditionallyCenteredTruncation_mem_Icc
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] (X : Omega → ℝ) (y : ℝ) :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      conditionallyCenteredTruncation mu m X y omega ∈
        Icc (-2 * |y|) (2 * |y|)

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasCondSubgaussianMGF_conditionallyCenteredTruncation
statement:
theorem hasCondSubgaussianMGF_conditionallyCenteredTruncation
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hm : m ≤ mOmega) {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X mu)
    (y : ℝ) :
    HasCondSubgaussianMGF m hm
      (conditionallyCenteredTruncation mu m X y)
      ((‖(2 * |y|) - (-2 * |y|)‖₊ / 2) ^ 2) mu

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasCondSubgaussianMGF_martingaleCenteredTruncation_succ
statement:
theorem hasCondSubgaussianMGF_martingaleCenteredTruncation_succ
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hD : StronglyAdapted filtration D)
    (y : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    HasCondSubgaussianMGF (filtration k) (filtration.le k)
      (martingaleCenteredTruncation filtration mu D y (k + 1))
      ((‖(2 * |y|) - (-2 * |y|)‖₊ / 2) ^ 2) mu

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasCondSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc_of_condExp_ae_eq_zero
statement:
theorem hasCondSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc_of_condExp_ae_eq_zero
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hm : m ≤ mOmega) {X : Omega → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hX : AEMeasurable X mu)
    (hb : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, X omega ∈ Icc a b)
    (hcenter : mu[X | m] =ᵐ[mu] 0) :
    HasCondSubgaussianMGF m hm X ((‖b - a‖₊ / 2) ^ 2) mu

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasSubgaussianMGF_martingaleCenteredTruncation_zero
statement:
theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_martingaleCenteredTruncation_zero
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ)
    (hD0 : AEMeasurable (D 0) mu) (y : ℝ) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF
      (martingaleCenteredTruncation filtration mu D y 0)
      ((‖(2 * |y|) - (-2 * |y|)‖₊ / 2) ^ 2) mu

name: ProbabilityTheory.integrable_conditionallyCenteredTruncation
statement:
theorem integrable_conditionallyCenteredTruncation
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu] {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X mu)
    (y : ℝ) :
    Integrable (conditionallyCenteredTruncation mu m X y) mu

name: ProbabilityTheory.integrable_finiteProcessSupremum
statement:
theorem integrable_finiteProcessSupremum
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty) (X : T → Omega → ℝ)
    (A : Omega → ℝ) (hA : Integrable A mu)
    (hX : ∀ t ∈ s, Measurable (X t))
    (hdom : ∀ omega t, t ∈ s → |X t omega| ≤ |A omega|) :
    Integrable (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) mu

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_doobCenteredDifference_zero
statement:
theorem integral_doobCenteredDifference_zero
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [SigmaFiniteFiltration mu filtration]
    (F : Omega → ℝ) :
    ∫ omega, doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F 0 omega ∂mu = 0

name: ProbabilityTheory.martingaleCenteredTruncation_add_center_eq
statement:
theorem martingaleCenteredTruncation_add_center_eq
    (mu : Measure Omega) (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (y : ℝ)
    (k : ℕ) (omega : Omega) (hsmall : |D k omega| < y) :
    martingaleCenteredTruncation filtration mu D y k omega +
        martingaleTruncationCenter filtration mu D y k omega =
      D k omega

name: ProbabilityTheory.martingale_sum_large_subset_iUnion_large_or_truncation
statement:
theorem martingale_sum_large_subset_iUnion_large_or_truncation
    (mu : Measure Omega) (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ)
    (y t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    {omega | t +
        |∑ k ∈ range n,
          martingaleTruncationCenter filtration mu D y k omega| ≤
        ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega} ⊆
      (⋃ k ∈ range n, {omega | y ≤ |D k omega|}) ∪
        {omega | t ≤
          ∑ k ∈ range n,
            martingaleCenteredTruncation filtration mu D y k omega}

name: ProbabilityTheory.measurable_finiteProcessSupremum
statement:
theorem measurable_finiteProcessSupremum
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty) (X : T → Omega → ℝ)
    (hX : ∀ t ∈ s, Measurable (X t)) :
    Measurable (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X)

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_martingale_sum_large_le_condMoment_bias_add_exp
statement:
theorem measureReal_martingale_sum_large_le_condMoment_bias_add_exp
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hD : StronglyAdapted filtration D)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hDq : ∀ k < n, Integrable (fun omega ↦ |D k omega| ^ q) mu)
    (hcenter0 : ∫ omega, D 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hcenterSucc : ∀ k < n - 1,
      mu[D (k + 1) | filtration k] =ᵐ[mu] 0)
    (K : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hmoment0 : absoluteMoment (D 0) q mu ≤ K 0)
    (hcondMoment : ∀ k < n - 1, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z ↦ |D (k + 1) z| ^ q | filtration k] omega ≤ K (k + 1))
    {y t : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    mu.real {omega |
        t + (∑ k ∈ range n, K k) / y ^ (q - 1) ≤
          ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega} ≤
      (∑ k ∈ range n, absoluteMoment (D k) q mu) / y ^ q +
        exp (-t ^ 2 / (8 * (n : ℝ) * y ^ 2))

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_martingale_sum_large_le_moment_div_add_exp
statement:
theorem measureReal_martingale_sum_large_le_moment_div_add_exp
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hD : StronglyAdapted filtration D)
    {q : ℕ}
    (hDq : ∀ k < n, Integrable (fun omega ↦ |D k omega| ^ q) mu)
    {y t : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    mu.real {omega | t +
        |∑ k ∈ range n,
          martingaleTruncationCenter filtration mu D y k omega| ≤
        ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega} ≤
      (∑ k ∈ range n, absoluteMoment (D k) q mu) / y ^ q +
        exp (-t ^ 2 / (8 * (n : ℝ) * y ^ 2))

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_martingale_sum_large_le_sum_large_add_truncation
statement:
theorem measureReal_martingale_sum_large_le_sum_large_add_truncation
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu] (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ)
    (y t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    mu.real {omega | t +
        |∑ k ∈ range n,
          martingaleTruncationCenter filtration mu D y k omega| ≤
        ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega} ≤
      (∑ k ∈ range n, mu.real {omega | y ≤ |D k omega|}) +
        mu.real {omega | t ≤
          ∑ k ∈ range n,
            martingaleCenteredTruncation filtration mu D y k omega}

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_sum_martingaleCenteredTruncation_ge_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_sum_martingaleCenteredTruncation_ge_le
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hD : StronglyAdapted filtration D)
    (y : ℝ) (n : ℕ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    mu.real {omega | t ≤
        ∑ k ∈ range n,
          martingaleCenteredTruncation filtration mu D y k omega} ≤
      exp (-t ^ 2 / (8 * (n : ℝ) * y ^ 2))

name: ProbabilityTheory.stronglyAdapted_doobCenteredDifference
statement:
theorem stronglyAdapted_doobCenteredDifference
    (mu : Measure Omega) (F : Omega → ℝ) :
    StronglyAdapted filtration (doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F)

name: ProbabilityTheory.stronglyAdapted_martingaleCenteredTruncation
statement:
theorem stronglyAdapted_martingaleCenteredTruncation
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu] (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (y : ℝ)
    (hD : StronglyAdapted filtration D) :
    StronglyAdapted filtration
      (martingaleCenteredTruncation filtration mu D y)

name: ProbabilityTheory.sum_doobCenteredDifference
statement:
theorem sum_doobCenteredDifference
    (mu : Measure Omega) (F : Omega → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (omega : Omega) :
    ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F k omega =
      mu[F | filtration n] omega - ∫ z, F z ∂mu

name: ProbabilityTheory.sum_martingaleCenteredTruncation_add_center_eq
statement:
theorem sum_martingaleCenteredTruncation_add_center_eq
    (mu : Measure Omega) (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (y : ℝ)
    (n : ℕ) (omega : Omega)
    (hsmall : ∀ k < n, |D k omega| < y) :
    (∑ k ∈ range n,
        martingaleCenteredTruncation filtration mu D y k omega) +
      (∑ k ∈ range n,
        martingaleTruncationCenter filtration mu D y k omega) =
      ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF.add_of_hasCondBernsteinMGF
statement:
theorem HasBernsteinMGF.add_of_hasCondBernsteinMGF
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {X Y : Omega → ℝ} {vX vY b : ℝ≥0}
    (hm : m ≤ mOmega) (hX : HasBernsteinMGF X vX b mu)
    (hXm : StronglyMeasurable[m] X)
    (hY : HasCondBernsteinMGF m hm Y vY b mu)
    {BX BY : ℝ} (hBX : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, |X omega| ≤ BX)
    (hBY : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, |Y omega| ≤ BY) :
    HasBernsteinMGF (fun omega ↦ X omega + Y omega) (vX + vY) b mu

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF.sum_of_hasCondBernsteinMGF
statement:
theorem HasBernsteinMGF.sum_of_hasCondBernsteinMGF
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {Y : ℕ → Omega → ℝ} {v : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {b : ℝ≥0}
    (hAdapted : StronglyAdapted filtration Y)
    (hzero : HasBernsteinMGF (Y 0) (v 0) b mu)
    (n : ℕ)
    (hbound : ∀ i < n, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, |Y i omega| ≤ (b : ℝ))
    (hcond : ∀ i < n - 1,
      HasCondBernsteinMGF (filtration i) (filtration.le i)
        (Y (i + 1)) (v (i + 1)) b mu) :
    HasBernsteinMGF (fun omega ↦ ∑ i ∈ range n, Y i omega)
      (∑ i ∈ range n, v i) b mu

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasCondBernsteinMGF.ae_condExp_le
statement:
theorem ae_condExp_le
    (hX : HasCondBernsteinMGF m hm X v b mu) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : (b : ℝ) * |t| < 1) :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z ↦ exp (t * X z) | m] omega ≤
        exp ((v : ℝ) * t ^ 2 /
          (2 * (1 - (b : ℝ) * |t|)))

name: ProbabilityTheory.ae_abs_sum_range_le_nat_mul
statement:
theorem ae_abs_sum_range_le_nat_mul
    {Y : ℕ → Omega → ℝ} {b : ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    (hbound : ∀ i < n, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, |Y i omega| ≤ b) :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      |∑ i ∈ range n, Y i omega| ≤ (n : ℝ) * b

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasCondBernsteinMGF_of_memLp_two_of_ae_abs_le_of_condExp_ae_eq_zero
statement:
theorem hasCondBernsteinMGF_of_memLp_two_of_ae_abs_le_of_condExp_ae_eq_zero
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hm : m ≤ mOmega) (X : Omega → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 2 mu)
    {v b : ℝ} (hv : 0 ≤ v) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, |X omega| ≤ b)
    (hcenter : mu[X | m] =ᵐ[mu] 0)
    (hsecond : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z ↦ X z ^ 2 | m] omega ≤ v) :
    HasCondBernsteinMGF m hm X
      ⟨2 * v, mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hv⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩ mu

name: ProbabilityTheory.integrable_exp_mul_add_of_ae_abs_le
statement:
theorem integrable_exp_mul_add_of_ae_abs_le
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    {X Y : Omega → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X mu) (hY : AEMeasurable Y mu)
    {BX BY : ℝ} (hBX : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, |X omega| ≤ BX)
    (hBY : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, |Y omega| ≤ BY) (t : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun omega ↦ exp (t * (X omega + Y omega))) mu

name: ProbabilityTheory.convexOn_expSeriesTail
statement:
theorem convexOn_expSeriesTail (q : ℕ) :
    ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) (expSeriesTail q)

name: ProbabilityTheory.expSeriesTail_le_div_mul_exp
statement:
theorem expSeriesTail_le_div_mul_exp
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 1 ≤ q) (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    expSeriesTail q x ≤ (x / q) * Real.exp x

name: ProbabilityTheory.expSeriesTail_le_exp
statement:
theorem expSeriesTail_le_exp (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (q : ℕ) :
    expSeriesTail q x ≤ Real.exp x

name: ProbabilityTheory.expSeriesTail_mul_le_ratio_pow_mul
statement:
theorem expSeriesTail_mul_le_ratio_pow_mul
    (q : ℕ) {t a y : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hay : a ≤ y) (hy : 0 < y) :
    expSeriesTail q (t * a) ≤
      (a / y) ^ q * expSeriesTail q (t * y)

name: ProbabilityTheory.expSeriesTail_nonneg
statement:
theorem expSeriesTail_nonneg {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (q : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ expSeriesTail q x

name: ProbabilityTheory.expSeriesTail_succ_le_mul_expSeriesTail
statement:
theorem expSeriesTail_succ_le_mul_expSeriesTail
    (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    expSeriesTail (n + 1) x ≤
      (x / (n + 1 : ℕ)) * expSeriesTail n x

name: ProbabilityTheory.expSeriesTail_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem expSeriesTail_zero {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    expSeriesTail q 0 = 0

name: ProbabilityTheory.exp_eq_sum_range_add_expSeriesTail
statement:
theorem exp_eq_sum_range_add_expSeriesTail (x : ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    Real.exp x =
      (∑ k ∈ range q, x ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) + expSeriesTail q x

name: ProbabilityTheory.exp_eq_sum_range_add_tsum_nat_add
statement:
theorem exp_eq_sum_range_add_tsum_nat_add (x : ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    Real.exp x =
      (∑ k ∈ range q, x ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) +
        ∑' k : ℕ, x ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ)

name: ProbabilityTheory.exp_le_oneSidedExpTaylorBound
statement:
theorem exp_le_oneSidedExpTaylorBound
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (x : ℝ) :
    Real.exp x ≤ oneSidedExpTaylorBound q x

name: ProbabilityTheory.exp_le_one_add_add_half_sq_of_nonpos
statement:
theorem exp_le_one_add_add_half_sq_of_nonpos
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≤ 0) :

name: ProbabilityTheory.exp_le_one_add_add_three_quarters_sq_of_nonpos
statement:
theorem exp_le_one_add_add_three_quarters_sq_of_nonpos

name: ProbabilityTheory.exp_le_sum_range_add_pow_div_factorial_mul_exp
statement:
theorem exp_le_sum_range_add_pow_div_factorial_mul_exp
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (q : ℕ) :
    Real.exp x ≤
      (∑ k ∈ range q, x ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) +

name: ProbabilityTheory.factorial_mul_factorial_cast_le_factorial_add_cast
statement:
theorem factorial_mul_factorial_cast_le_factorial_add_cast (q k : ℕ) :
    (q.factorial : ℝ) * (k.factorial : ℝ) ≤ ((q + k).factorial : ℝ)

name: ProbabilityTheory.pow_add_div_factorial_add_le_mul_pow_div_factorial
statement:
theorem pow_add_div_factorial_add_le_mul_pow_div_factorial
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (q k : ℕ) :
    x ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ) ≤

name: ProbabilityTheory.summable_expSeriesTail
statement:
theorem summable_expSeriesTail (q : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :

name: ProbabilityTheory.summable_expSeries_nat_add
statement:
theorem summable_expSeries_nat_add (x : ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    Summable (fun k : ℕ => x ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ))

name: ProbabilityTheory.tsum_pow_add_div_factorial_add_le
statement:
theorem tsum_pow_add_div_factorial_add_le (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (q : ℕ) :
    (∑' k : ℕ, x ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ)) ≤
      (x ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ)) * Real.exp x

name: ProbabilityTheory.aemeasurable_upperTruncation
ProbabilityTheory.integrable_pow_max_upperTruncation_zero
statement:
theorem integrable_pow_max_upperTruncation_zero
    {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X mu) (y : ℝ) (k : ℕ)

name: ProbabilityTheory.integrable_sq_upperTruncation
statement:
theorem integrable_sq_upperTruncation
    {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X mu)
    (hXsq : Integrable (fun omega => X omega ^ 2) mu)

    (hmgf : HasOneSidedMGF

        upperTruncation (D i) y omega) psi mu) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, D i omega) mu ≤
      (psi t - Real.log alpha) / t +
        alpha⁻¹ *

statement:

    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hAdapted : StronglyAdapted filtration D)
    (second : ℕ → ℝ) (moment : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (n q : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {y alpha t : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y)
    (hD : ∀ i < n, Integrable (D i) mu)
    (hDsq : ∀ i < n, Integrable (fun omega => D i omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ i < n, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (D i omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hcenter0 : ∫ omega, D 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hcenterSucc : ∀ i < n - 1,
      mu[D (i + 1) | filtration i] =ᵐ[mu] 0)
    (hsecond0 : (∫ omega, D 0 omega ^ 2 ∂mu) ≤ second 0)
    (hsecondSucc : ∀ i < n - 1,
      mu[fun omega => D (i + 1) omega ^ 2 | filtration i] ≤ᵐ[mu]
        fun _ => second (i + 1))
    (hmoment0 : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      (∫ omega, (max (D 0 omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu) ≤ moment 0 k)
    (hmomentSucc : ∀ i < n - 1, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      mu[fun omega => (max (D (i + 1) omega) 0) ^ k | filtration i]
        ≤ᵐ[mu] fun _ => moment (i + 1) k)
    (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1) (ht : 0 < t) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, D i omega) mu ≤
      (strongMomentTaylorExponent q t y
          (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, second i)
          (fun k => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, moment i k) -
        Real.log alpha) / t +
      alpha⁻¹ *
        ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, moment i q) /

theorem upperTruncationResidual_le_pow_div_natCast_mul
    (X : Omega → ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 1 ≤ q) (omega : Omega) :
    upperTruncationResidual X y omega ≤
      (max (X omega) 0) ^ q /
        ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1))

name: ProbabilityTheory.tendsto_conditionalValueAtRisk_centered_of_tendsto_integral_abs_sub
statement:
theorem tendsto_conditionalValueAtRisk_centered_of_tendsto_integral_abs_sub
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ} {Y : Omega → ℝ}
    (hX : ∀ n, Integrable (X n) mu) (hY : Integrable Y mu)
    {alpha : ℝ} (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1)
    (hL1 : Tendsto (fun n ↦ ∫ omega, |X n omega - Y omega| ∂mu)
      atTop (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto
      (fun n ↦ conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega ↦ X n omega - ∫ z, X n z ∂mu) mu)
      atTop
      (nhds (conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega ↦ Y omega - ∫ z, Y z ∂mu) mu))

statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_centered_iSup_le_of_densePrefixes
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (F : Omega → T → ℝ) (B : Omega → ℝ)
    (hcontinuous : ∀ omega, Continuous (F omega))
    (hmeas : ∀ k, Measurable (fun omega ↦ F omega (denseSeq T k)))
    (hB : Integrable B mu)
    (hdom : ∀ omega t, |F omega t| ≤ |B omega|)
    {alpha C : ℝ} (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1)
    (hfinite : ∀ n,
      ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk alpha

          densePrefixSupremum (F omega) n -
            ∫ z, densePrefixSupremum (F z) n ∂mu) mu ≤ C) :
    ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega ↦

    (hS : ∀ i, RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable (S i))

    (hTcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (T ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hTne : ∀ ω, (T ω).Nonempty)
    (hLaw : Tendsto
      (fun i => (νs i).map
        (measurable_bundleNonemptyCompacts
          (hS i) (hScompact i) (hSne i)).aemeasurable) L
      (𝓝 (ν.map
        (measurable_bundleNonemptyCompacts
          hT hTcompact hTne).aemeasurable))) :
    (∀ U : Set X, IsOpen U →
      capacityFunctional (ν : Measure Ω') T U ≤
        L.liminf (fun i =>
          capacityFunctional (νs i : Measure Ω) (S i) U)) ∧
    (∀ F : Set X, IsClosed F →
      L.limsup (fun i =>
          capacityFunctional (νs i : Measure Ω) (S i) F) ≤
        capacityFunctional (ν : Measure Ω') T F)

name: ProbabilityTheory.exp_mul_le_exactStrongMomentMajorant
statement:
theorem exp_mul_le_exactStrongMomentMajorant
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) {t x y : ℝ}
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hy : 0 < y) (hxy : x ≤ y) :
    Real.exp (t * x) ≤
      1 + t * x + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (t * x) ^ 2 +
        (∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q,
          (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max x 0) ^ k) +
        (expSeriesTail q (t * y) / y ^ q) * (max x 0) ^ q

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_exp_mul_le_exp_strongMomentSeriesExponent
statement:
theorem integral_exp_mul_le_exp_strongMomentSeriesExponent
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : Omega → ℝ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {t y : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hX : Integrable X mu)
    (hXsq : Integrable (fun omega => X omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hupper : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, X omega ≤ y)
    (hcenter : (∫ omega, X omega ∂mu) ≤ 0) :
    (∫ omega, Real.exp (t * X omega) ∂mu) ≤
      Real.exp (strongMomentSeriesExponent q t y
        (∫ omega, X omega ^ 2 ∂mu)
        (fun k => ∫ omega, (max (X omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu))

name: ProbabilityTheory.sum_strongMomentSeriesExponent
statement:
theorem sum_strongMomentSeriesExponent
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (q : ℕ) (t y : ℝ)
    (second : ι → ℝ) (moment : ι → ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, strongMomentSeriesExponent q t y (second i) (moment i)) =
      strongMomentSeriesExponent q t y
        (∑ i ∈ s, second i) (fun k => ∑ i ∈ s, moment i k)

name: ProbabilityTheory.condExp_exp_mul_le_exp_strongMomentSeriesExponent
statement:
theorem condExp_exp_mul_le_exp_strongMomentSeriesExponent
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hm : m ≤ mOmega) (X : Omega → ℝ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {t y second : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hX : Integrable X mu)
    (hXsq : Integrable (fun omega => X omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hupper : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, X omega ≤ y)
    (hcenter : mu[X | m] ≤ᵐ[mu] 0)
    (hsecond : mu[fun omega => X omega ^ 2 | m] ≤ᵐ[mu]
      fun _ => second)
    (moment : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hmoment : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      mu[fun omega => (max (X omega) 0) ^ k | m] ≤ᵐ[mu]
        fun _ => moment k) :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z => Real.exp (t * X z) | m] omega ≤
        Real.exp (strongMomentSeriesExponent q t y second moment)

name: ProbabilityTheory.condExp_exp_mul_upperTruncation_le_exp_strongMomentSeriesExponent
statement:
theorem condExp_exp_mul_upperTruncation_le_exp_strongMomentSeriesExponent
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hm : m ≤ mOmega) (D : Omega → ℝ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {t y second : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hD : Integrable D mu)
    (hDsq : Integrable (fun omega => D omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (D omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hcenter : mu[D | m] =ᵐ[mu] 0)
    (hsecond : mu[fun omega => D omega ^ 2 | m] ≤ᵐ[mu]
      fun _ => second)
    (moment : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hmoment : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      mu[fun omega => (max (D omega) 0) ^ k | m] ≤ᵐ[mu]
        fun _ => moment k) :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z => Real.exp (t * upperTruncation D y z) | m] omega ≤
        Real.exp (strongMomentSeriesExponent q t y second moment)

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_sum_le_strongMomentSeriesExponent_add_residual
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_sum_le_strongMomentSeriesExponent_add_residual
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hAdapted : StronglyAdapted filtration D)
    (second : ℕ → ℝ) (moment : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (n q : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {y alpha t : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y)
    (hD : ∀ i < n, Integrable (D i) mu)
    (hDsq : ∀ i < n, Integrable (fun omega => D i omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ i < n, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (D i omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hcenter0 : ∫ omega, D 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hcenterSucc : ∀ i < n - 1,
      mu[D (i + 1) | filtration i] =ᵐ[mu] 0)
    (hsecond0 : (∫ omega, D 0 omega ^ 2 ∂mu) ≤ second 0)
    (hsecondSucc : ∀ i < n - 1,
      mu[fun omega => D (i + 1) omega ^ 2 | filtration i] ≤ᵐ[mu]
        fun _ => second (i + 1))
    (hmoment0 : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      (∫ omega, (max (D 0 omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu) ≤ moment 0 k)
    (hmomentSucc : ∀ i < n - 1, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      mu[fun omega => (max (D (i + 1) omega) 0) ^ k | filtration i]
        ≤ᵐ[mu] fun _ => moment (i + 1) k)
    (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1) (ht : 0 < t) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, D i omega) mu ≤
      (strongMomentSeriesExponent q t y
          (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, second i)
          (fun k => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, moment i k) -
        Real.log alpha) / t +
      alpha⁻¹ *
        ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, moment i q) /
          ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1)))

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasCondOneSidedMGF_upperTruncation_of_strongMomentSeries
statement:
theorem hasCondOneSidedMGF_upperTruncation_of_strongMomentSeries
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hm : m ≤ mOmega) (D : Omega → ℝ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {y second : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y)
    (hD : Integrable D mu)

    (hpow : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,

    (hcenter : mu[D | m] =ᵐ[mu] 0)
    (hsecond : mu[fun omega => D omega ^ 2 | m] ≤ᵐ[mu]
      fun _ => second)
    (moment : ℕ → ℝ)

      mu[fun omega => (max (D omega) 0) ^ k | m] ≤ᵐ[mu]

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasOneSidedMGF_sum_upperTruncation_of_strongMomentSeries
statement:
theorem hasOneSidedMGF_sum_upperTruncation_of_strongMomentSeries
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hAdapted : StronglyAdapted filtration D)
    (second : ℕ → ℝ) (moment : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (n q : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y)
    (hD : ∀ i < n, Integrable (D i) mu)
    (hDsq : ∀ i < n, Integrable (fun omega => D i omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ i < n, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (D i omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hcenter0 : ∫ omega, D 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hcenterSucc : ∀ i < n - 1,
      mu[D (i + 1) | filtration i] =ᵐ[mu] 0)
    (hsecond0 : (∫ omega, D 0 omega ^ 2 ∂mu) ≤ second 0)
    (hsecondSucc : ∀ i < n - 1,
      mu[fun omega => D (i + 1) omega ^ 2 | filtration i] ≤ᵐ[mu]
        fun _ => second (i + 1))
    (hmoment0 : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      (∫ omega, (max (D 0 omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu) ≤ moment 0 k)
    (hmomentSucc : ∀ i < n - 1, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      mu[fun omega => (max (D (i + 1) omega) 0) ^ k | filtration i]
        ≤ᵐ[mu] fun _ => moment (i + 1) k) :
    HasOneSidedMGF
      (fun omega => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, upperTruncation (D i) y omega)
      (fun t => strongMomentSeriesExponent q t y
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, second i)
        (fun k => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, moment i k)) mu

statement:

    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : Omega → ℝ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)

name: ProbabilityTheory.strongMomentSeriesExponent_mono
statement:
theorem strongMomentSeriesExponent_mono
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) {t y second second' : ℝ}
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hy : 0 < y) (hsecond : second ≤ second')
    {moment moment' : ℕ → ℝ}

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_finiteProcessSupremum_sub_integral_le_strongMomentSeries
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_finiteProcessSupremum_sub_integral_le_strongMomentSeries
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [SigmaFiniteFiltration mu filtration]
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty) (X : T → Omega → ℝ)
    (A : Omega → ℝ) (hA : Integrable A mu)
    (hX : ∀ u ∈ s, Measurable (X u))
    (hdom : ∀ omega u, u ∈ s → |X u omega| ≤ |A omega|)
    (second : ℕ → ℝ) (moment : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (n q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (hterminal : mu[finiteProcessSupremum s hs X | filtration n]
      =ᵐ[mu] finiteProcessSupremum s hs X)
    (hDsq : ∀ i < n + 1, Integrable (fun omega ↦
      doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
        (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) i omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ i < n + 1, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega ↦
        (max (doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
          (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) i omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hsecond0 : (∫ omega,
      doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
        (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) 0 omega ^ 2 ∂mu) ≤ second 0)
    (hsecondSucc : ∀ i < n,
      mu[fun omega ↦ doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
          (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) (i + 1) omega ^ 2 |
        filtration i] ≤ᵐ[mu] fun _ ↦ second (i + 1))
    (hmoment0 : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      (∫ omega, (max (doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
        (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) 0 omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu) ≤
        moment 0 k)
    (hmomentSucc : ∀ i < n, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      mu[fun omega ↦ (max (doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
          (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) (i + 1) omega) 0) ^ k |
        filtration i] ≤ᵐ[mu] fun _ ↦ moment (i + 1) k)
    {y alpha t : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y)
    (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1) (ht : 0 < t) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega ↦ finiteProcessSupremum s hs X omega -
          ∫ z, finiteProcessSupremum s hs X z ∂mu) mu ≤
      (strongMomentSeriesExponent q t y
          (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), second i)
          (fun k ↦ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), moment i k) -
        Real.log alpha) / t +
      alpha⁻¹ *
        ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), moment i q) /
          ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1)))

    (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {y second V Q alpha : ℝ} {moment : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hy : 0 < y) (hV : 0 < V) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q)
    (hsecond : second ≤ V)
    (hmiddle : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
      moment k ≤ interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient q V Q k)

    (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha < 1)

      Real.sqrt (2 * V * (-Real.log alpha)) +

theorem strongMomentIntermediateExponent_le_bernstein_geometric
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) {V Q c t : ℝ}

        V * c ^ (k - 2)) :

      gaussianChernoffExponent V t *
        ((c * t / 3) / (1 - c * t / 3))

name: ProbabilityTheory.chernoffTransform_rioStrongMomentExponent_le_explicit
statement:
theorem chernoffTransform_rioStrongMomentExponent_le_explicit

    chernoffTransform (rioStrongMomentExponent q V Q y) x ≤

name: ProbabilityTheory.chernoffTransform_rioStrongMomentExponent_one_min_le
statement:

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_sum_le_rioStrongMoment_explicit
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_sum_le_rioStrongMoment_explicit
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hAdapted : StronglyAdapted filtration D)
    (second : ℕ → ℝ) (moment : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (n q : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {V Q y alpha : ℝ} (hV : 0 < V) (hQ : 0 < Q) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hD : ∀ i < n, Integrable (D i) mu)
    (hDsq : ∀ i < n, Integrable (fun omega ↦ D i omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ i < n, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega ↦ (max (D i omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hcenter0 : ∫ omega, D 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hcenterSucc : ∀ i < n - 1,
      mu[D (i + 1) | filtration i] =ᵐ[mu] 0)
    (hsecond0 : (∫ omega, D 0 omega ^ 2 ∂mu) ≤ second 0)
    (hsecondSucc : ∀ i < n - 1,
      mu[fun omega ↦ D (i + 1) omega ^ 2 | filtration i] ≤ᵐ[mu]
        fun _ ↦ second (i + 1))
    (hmoment0 : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      (∫ omega, (max (D 0 omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu) ≤ moment 0 k)
    (hmomentSucc : ∀ i < n - 1, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      mu[fun omega ↦ (max (D (i + 1) omega) 0) ^ k | filtration i]
        ≤ᵐ[mu] fun _ ↦ moment (i + 1) k)
    (hsecond : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, second i) ≤ V)
    (hmiddle : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, moment i k) ≤
        interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient q V Q k)
    (hmomentQ : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, moment i q) ≤ Q)
    (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha < 1)
    (hscale : Q * Real.exp (-Real.log alpha) ≤ y ^ q) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega ↦ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, D i omega) mu ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * V * (-Real.log alpha)) +
        (1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) * y +
          Real.exp 1 * strongMomentQScale q Q * (-Real.log alpha) / 3 +
        alpha⁻¹ * (Q / ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1)))

name: ProbabilityTheory.inv_mul_strongMomentResidual_le_div
statement:
theorem inv_mul_strongMomentResidual_le_div
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 1 ≤ q) {Q y alpha : ℝ}
    (hy : 0 < y) (halpha0 : 0 < alpha)

    alpha⁻¹ * (Q / ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1))) ≤ y / (q : ℝ)

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_finiteProcessSupremum_sub_integral_le_rioStrongMoment
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_finiteProcessSupremum_sub_integral_le_rioStrongMoment
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [SigmaFiniteFiltration mu filtration]
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty) (X : T → Omega → ℝ)
    (A : Omega → ℝ) (hA : Integrable A mu)
    (hX : ∀ u ∈ s, Measurable (X u))
    (hdom : ∀ omega u, u ∈ s → |X u omega| ≤ |A omega|)
    (second : ℕ → ℝ) (moment : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (n q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {V Q y alpha : ℝ} (hV : 0 < V) (hQ : 0 < Q) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hterminal : mu[finiteProcessSupremum s hs X | filtration n]
      =ᵐ[mu] finiteProcessSupremum s hs X)
    (hDsq : ∀ i < n + 1, Integrable (fun omega ↦
      doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
        (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) i omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ i < n + 1, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega ↦
        (max (doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
          (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) i omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hsecond0 : (∫ omega,
      doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
        (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) 0 omega ^ 2 ∂mu) ≤ second 0)
    (hsecondSucc : ∀ i < n,
      mu[fun omega ↦ doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
          (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) (i + 1) omega ^ 2 |
        filtration i] ≤ᵐ[mu] fun _ ↦ second (i + 1))
    (hmoment0 : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      (∫ omega, (max (doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
        (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) 0 omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu) ≤
        moment 0 k)
    (hmomentSucc : ∀ i < n, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      mu[fun omega ↦ (max (doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
          (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) (i + 1) omega) 0) ^ k |
        filtration i] ≤ᵐ[mu] fun _ ↦ moment (i + 1) k)
    (hsecond : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), second i) ≤ V)
    (hmiddle : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), moment i k) ≤
        interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient q V Q k)
    (hmomentQ : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), moment i q) ≤ Q)
    (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha < 1)
    (hscale : Q * Real.exp (-Real.log alpha) ≤ y ^ q) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega ↦ finiteProcessSupremum s hs X omega -
          ∫ z, finiteProcessSupremum s hs X z ∂mu) mu ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * V * (-Real.log alpha)) +
        (1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) * y +
          Real.exp 1 * strongMomentQScale q Q * (-Real.log alpha) / 3 +
        alpha⁻¹ * (Q / ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1)))

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_finiteReplaceOneSupremum_sub_integral_le_two_mul
statement:
theorem abs_finiteReplaceOneSupremum_sub_integral_le_two_mul
    [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (r : T -> Real) (X : Z -> T -> Real) (A : Z -> Real)

statement:
theorem condExp_sq_centeredGhostFiber_le

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasBernsteinMGF_finiteReplaceOneSupremum_sub_integral
statement:
theorem hasBernsteinMGF_finiteReplaceOneSupremum_sub_integral
    [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (r : T -> Real) (X : Z -> T -> Real) (A : Z -> Real)
    (hX : forall t, t ∈ s -> Measurable (fun z => X z t))
    (hA : forall z, 0 <= A z)
    (hdom : forall z t, t ∈ s -> |X z t| <= A z)
    (hA2 : MemLp A 2 nu)
    {K2 B : Real} (hB : 0 <= B)
    (hAbound : forall z, A z <= B)
    (hsecond : integral nu (fun z => A z ^ 2) <= K2 ^ 2) :
    HasBernsteinMGF
      (fun z => finiteReplaceOneSupremum s hs r X z -
        integral nu (finiteReplaceOneSupremum s hs r X))
      ⟨4 * K2 ^ 2, mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (sq_nonneg K2)⟩

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_finiteSupremum_le_rio_of_iidGhostFibers
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_finiteSupremum_le_rio_of_iidGhostFibers
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [StandardBorelSpace Z] [Nonempty Z] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (z0 : Z) (Y : Nat -> Omega -> Z)
    (hY : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i)) (hIndep : iIndepFun Y mu)
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty) (X : T -> Omega -> Real)
    (B : Omega -> Real) (hB : Integrable B mu)
    (hdom : ∀ omega u, u ∈ s -> abs (X u omega) <= abs (B omega))
    (G : Nat -> (Nat -> Z) -> Z -> Real) (Acoord : Nat -> Z -> Real)
    (n q : Nat) (hq : 3 <= q)
    {V Q y alpha : Real} (hV : 0 < V) (hQ : 0 < Q) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hYlaw : ∀ i < n, mu.map (Y i) = nu)
    (hXprefix : ∀ u ∈ s,
      Measurable[strictPrefixFiltration Y hY n] (X u))
    (hG : ∀ i < n, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (G i)))
    (hAq : ∀ j < n + 1, MemLp (Acoord j) q nu)
    (hA : ∀ j < n + 1, ∀ z, 0 <= Acoord j z)
    (hreplace : ∀ i < n, ∀ b z z',
      abs (G i b z - G i b z') <=
        Acoord (i + 1) z + Acoord (i + 1) z')
    (hnext : ∀ i < n,
      mu[finiteProcessSupremum s hs X |
          strictPrefixFiltration Y hY (i + 1)] =ᵐ[mu]
        fun omega =>
          G i (paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y i omega) (Y i omega))
    (hsecond :
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (Acoord j) 2) <= V)
    (hmomentQ :
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (Acoord j) q) <= Q)
    (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha < 1)
    (hscale : Q * Real.exp (-Real.log alpha) <= y ^ q) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega => finiteProcessSupremum s hs X omega -
          ∫ z, finiteProcessSupremum s hs X z ∂mu) mu <=
      Real.sqrt (2 * V * (-Real.log alpha)) +
        (1 + 1 / (q : Real)) * y +
          Real.exp 1 * strongMomentQScale q Q * (-Real.log alpha) / 3 +
        alpha⁻¹ * (Q / ((q : Real) * y ^ (q - 1)))

          (finiteCoordinateSumSupremum s hs W) past current -

            ∫ z, (⨆ t, finiteCoordinateSumProcess Y W t z) ∂mu) mu <=

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_iSup_empiricalAverageProcess_le_polynomialRate
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_iSup_empiricalAverageProcess_le_polynomialRate
    {mu : Measure Omega} {nu : Measure Z}
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [StandardBorelSpace Z] [Nonempty Z] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (z0 : Z) (Y : Nat → Omega → Z)
    (hY : forall i, Measurable (Y i)) (hIndep : iIndepFun Y mu)
    (n q : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (W : Fin n → Z → T → Real) (A : Fin n → Z → Real)
    (hYlaw : forall i, i < n → mu.map (Y i) = nu)
    (hWmeas : forall i t, Measurable (fun z ↦ W i z t))
    (hWcontinuous : forall i z, Continuous (W i z))
    (hAq : forall i, MemLp (A i) q nu)
    (hA : forall i z, 0 ≤ A i z)
    (hdom : forall i z t, abs (W i z t) ≤ A i z)
    (Ktwo Kq : Real) (hKtwo : 0 < Ktwo) (hKq : 0 < Kq)
    (hsecond : forall i, (∫ z, A i z ^ 2 ∂nu) ≤ Ktwo ^ 2)
    (hqmoment : forall i, (∫ z, A i z ^ q ∂nu) ≤ Kq ^ q)
    {alpha : Real} (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha < 1) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega ↦
          (⨆ t, finiteCoordinateSumProcess Y
              (empiricalNormalizedKernel n W) t omega) -
            ∫ z, (⨆ t, finiteCoordinateSumProcess Y
              (empiricalNormalizedKernel n W) t z) ∂mu) mu ≤
      Real.sqrt
          (2 * (4 * Ktwo ^ 2 / (n : Real)) * (-Real.log alpha)) +
        rioPolynomialCoefficient q * empiricalPolynomialScale q n Kq *
          (1 / alpha) ^ (1 / (q : Real))

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_iSup_empiricalAverageProcess_le_rioConfidence
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_iSup_empiricalAverageProcess_le_rioConfidence
    {mu : Measure Omega} {nu : Measure Z}
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [StandardBorelSpace Z] [Nonempty Z] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (z0 : Z) (Y : Nat → Omega → Z)
    (hY : forall i, Measurable (Y i)) (hIndep : iIndepFun Y mu)
    (n q : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (W : Fin n → Z → T → Real) (A : Fin n → Z → Real)
    (hYlaw : forall i, i < n → mu.map (Y i) = nu)
    (hWmeas : forall i t, Measurable (fun z ↦ W i z t))
    (hWcontinuous : forall i z, Continuous (W i z))
    (hAq : forall i, MemLp (A i) q nu)
    (hA : forall i z, 0 ≤ A i z)
    (hdom : forall i z t, abs (W i z t) ≤ A i z)
    (Ktwo Kq : Real) (hKtwo : 0 < Ktwo) (hKq : 0 < Kq)
    (hsecond : forall i, (∫ z, A i z ^ 2 ∂nu) ≤ Ktwo ^ 2)
    (hqmoment : forall i, (∫ z, A i z ^ q ∂nu) ≤ Kq ^ q)
    {alpha : Real} (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha < 1) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega ↦
          (⨆ t, finiteCoordinateSumProcess Y
              (empiricalNormalizedKernel n W) t omega) -
            ∫ z, (⨆ t, finiteCoordinateSumProcess Y
              (empiricalNormalizedKernel n W) t z) ∂mu) mu ≤
      rioStrongMomentConfidenceRadius q
        (4 * Ktwo ^ 2 / (n : Real))
        ((2 : Real) ^ q * Kq ^ q / (n : Real) ^ (q - 1)) alpha

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_euclideanUnitBall_coherentParentChaining
statement:
theorem exists_euclideanUnitBall_coherentParentChaining
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (eps : ℕ → ℝ) (heps : ∀ k, 0 < eps k) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ N : ℕ → Finset (EuclideanUnitBall E),
      ∃ parent proj : ℕ → EuclideanUnitBall E → EuclideanUnitBall E,
        (∀ k, ∀ u : EuclideanUnitBall E,
          ∃ v ∈ N k, dist u v ≤ eps k) ∧
        (∀ k, ((N k).card : ℝ) ≤
          (1 + 2 / eps k) ^ finrank ℝ E) ∧
        (∀ k u, parent k u ∈ N k ∧
          dist u (parent k u) ≤ eps k) ∧
        (∀ k, k ≤ m → ∀ u, proj k u ∈ N k) ∧
        (∀ u, dist u (proj m u) ≤ eps m) ∧
        (∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u,
          parent k (proj (k + 1) u) = proj k u) ∧
        (∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u,
          (proj (k + 1) u, proj k u) ∈
            ProbabilityTheory.finiteChainingParentEdges N parent k) ∧
        ∀ k, (ProbabilityTheory.finiteChainingParentEdges N parent k).card ≤
          (N (k + 1)).card

theorem measureReal_mixedEuclideanContinuousProcess_largeDeviation_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (Z : Ω → T → ℝ) (N0 : Finset T)
    (edges : ℕ → Finset (T × T)) (proj : ℕ → T → T)
    (d : ℕ) {σ₂ σ₁ x : ℝ}
    (hσ₂ : 0 ≤ σ₂) (hσ₁ : 0 ≤ σ₁) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (hcontinuous : ∀ ω, Continuous (Z ω))
    (hbase : ∀ t, proj 0 t ∈ N0)
    (hedge : ∀ k t, (proj (k + 1) t, proj k t) ∈ edges k)
    (hproj : ∀ t, Tendsto (fun k => proj k t) atTop (nhds t))
    (hbaseZero : ∀ ω, ∀ u ∈ N0, Z ω u = 0)
    (hedgeDist : ∀ k, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      dist e.1 e.2 ≤ 3 * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k))
    (hedgeCard : ∀ k,
      ((edges k).card : ℝ) ≤
        Real.exp (4 * (d : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ)))
    (hmixedTail : ∀ s t (y : ℝ), 0 ≤ y →
      μ.real {ω |
        σ₂ * dist s t * Real.sqrt (2 * y) +
            2 * σ₁ * dist s t * y < |Z ω s - Z ω t|} ≤
        2 * Real.exp (-y)) :
    μ.real {ω | ∃ t,
        6 * σ₂ * Real.sqrt (2 * x) +
            72 * σ₂ * Real.sqrt (d + 1 : ℝ) +
            12 * σ₁ * x + 144 * σ₁ * (d + 1 : ℝ) <
          |Z ω t|} ≤
      Real.exp (-x)

    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) {M K : ℝ} (c : ℝ≥0)
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (X : ι → Ω → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hH : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t)) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (I : Finset ι)
    (hRL2 : ∀ i ∈ I, MemLp (fun ω ↦ R (X i ω)) 2 μ)
    (hRsecond : ∀ i ∈ I, ∫ ω, R (X i ω) ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ K ^ 2)
    (s t : T) :
    HasBernsteinMGF
      (fun ω ↦ (c : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ I,
        (truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s t ω -
          ∫ ξ, truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s t ξ ∂μ))
      (c ^ 2 *
        ∑ _i ∈ I, nnrealOfNonneg (2 * (K * dist s t) ^ 2) (by positivity))
      (c *
        nnrealOfNonneg (2 * (M * dist s t)) (by positivity)) μ

statement:
theorem measureReal_centeredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess_increment_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) {M K : ℝ} (c : ℝ≥0)
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hK : 0 < K) (hc : 0 < c)
    (X : ι → Ω → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hH : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t)) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (I : Finset ι) (hI : I.Nonempty)
    (hRL2 : ∀ i ∈ I, MemLp (fun ω ↦ R (X i ω)) 2 μ)
    (hRsecond : ∀ i ∈ I, ∫ ω, R (X i ω) ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ K ^ 2)
    (s t : T) (hdist : 0 < dist s t) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    let v : ℝ≥0 := c ^ 2 *
      ∑ _i ∈ I, nnrealOfNonneg (2 * (K * dist s t) ^ 2) (by positivity)
    let b : ℝ≥0 := c *
      nnrealOfNonneg (2 * (M * dist s t)) (by positivity)
    μ.real { ω |
      Real.sqrt (2 * (v : ℝ) * y) + 2 * (b : ℝ) * y ≤
        |(c : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ I,
          (truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s t ω -
            ∫ ξ, truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s t ξ ∂μ)| } ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-y)

    (hRsecond : ∀ i, ∫ ω, R (X i ω) ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ K ^ 2)
    (n : ℕ) (s t : T) (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    μ.real { ω |
      (2 * K) * dist s t * Real.sqrt (2 * y) +
          2 * (2 * a) * dist s t * y <
        |(Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          (truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R
              (a * Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) X i s t ω -
            ∫ ξ, truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R
              (a * Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) X i s t ξ ∂μ)| } ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-y)

statement:
theorem measureReal_unitBall_mixedPolynomialEmpiricalProcess_confidence_le
    (Z G : Omega → EuclideanUnitBall E → ℝ) (A : Omega → ℝ)
    {n q : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hq : 0 < q)
    {sigma2 sigma1 x Kq delta : ℝ}
    (hsigma2 : 0 ≤ sigma2) (hsigma1 : 0 ≤ sigma1) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (hKq : 0 < Kq) (hdelta : 0 < delta)
    (hGcontinuous : ∀ omega, Continuous (G omega))
    (hGzero : ∀ omega, G omega ⟨0, by simp⟩ = 0)
    (hGmixed : ∀ (s t : EuclideanUnitBall E) (z : ℝ), 0 ≤ z →
      mu.real {omega |
        sigma2 * dist s t * Real.sqrt (2 * z) +
            2 * sigma1 * dist s t * z <
          |G omega s - G omega t|} ≤
        2 * Real.exp (-z))
    (hAq : Integrable (fun omega ↦ |A omega| ^ q) mu)
    (hAmoment : absoluteMoment A q mu ≤ Kq ^ q)
    (hdom : ∀ omega t,
      |Z omega t - G omega t| ≤
        (n : ℝ) ^ (-1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) * |A omega|) :
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
        mixedEuclideanProcessBound sigma2 sigma1 (finrank ℝ E) x +
            fukNagaevConstant q * Kq *
              (1 / delta) ^ (1 / (q : ℝ)) *
              (n : ℝ) ^ (-1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) <
          |Z omega t|} ≤
      Real.exp (-x) + delta

    (hGzero : ∀ omega, G omega ⟨0, by simp⟩ = 0)
    (hGsubgaussian : ∀ (s t : EuclideanUnitBall E) (z : ℝ), 0 ≤ z →
      mu.real {omega |
        (K2 / Real.sqrt n) * dist s t * Real.sqrt (2 * z) <
          |G omega s - G omega t|} ≤
        2 * Real.exp (-z))
    (hAq : Integrable (fun omega ↦ |A omega| ^ q) mu)
    (hAmoment : absoluteMoment A q mu ≤ Kq ^ q)
    (hdom : ∀ omega t,
      |Z omega t - G omega t| ≤
        (n : ℝ) ^ (-1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) * |A omega|) :
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
        6 * (K2 / Real.sqrt n) * Real.sqrt (2 * x) +
            72 * (K2 / Real.sqrt n) *
              Real.sqrt (finrank ℝ E + 1 : ℝ) +
            fukNagaevConstant q * Kq *
              (1 / delta) ^ (1 / (q : ℝ)) *
              (n : ℝ) ^ (-1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) <
          |Z omega t|} ≤
      Real.exp (-x) + delta

    let confidence := mixedEuclideanConfidence d x k

      dist s t < delta ∧

      mixedEuclideanEntropyCost d x k

          finiteReplaceOneCenteredSupremum (mu.map Y) s hs r X
            (P omega, Y omega)) :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z ↦
        doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F (k + 1) z ^ 2 |
          filtration k] omega ≤
        2 * ∫ z, A z ^ 2 ∂(mu.map Y)

statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_finiteCoordinateSumAbsSupremum_le_rio
    {mu : Measure Omega} {nu : Measure Z}
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [StandardBorelSpace Z] [Nonempty Z] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (z0 : Z) (Y : Nat → Omega → Z)
    (hY : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i)) (hIndep : iIndepFun Y mu)
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (n q : Nat) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (W : Fin n → Z → T → ℝ) (A : Fin n → Z → ℝ)
    (hYlaw : ∀ i, i < n → mu.map (Y i) = nu)
    (hW : ∀ j t, t ∈ s → Measurable (fun z ↦ W j z t))
    (hAq : ∀ j, MemLp (A j) q nu)
    (hA : ∀ j z, 0 ≤ A j z)
    (hdom : ∀ j z t, t ∈ s → |W j z t| ≤ A j z)
    {V Q y alpha : ℝ} (hV : 0 < V) (hQ : 0 < Q) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hsecond :
      (∑ i : Fin n, replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (A i) 2) ≤ V)
    (hmomentQ :
      (∑ i : Fin n, replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (A i) q) ≤ Q)
    (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha < 1)
    (hscale : Q * Real.exp (-Real.log alpha) ≤ y ^ q) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega ↦
          finiteCoordinateSumAbsSupremum s hs W
              (fun j ↦ Y j omega) -
            ∫ z, finiteCoordinateSumAbsSupremum s hs W
              (fun j ↦ Y j z) ∂mu) mu ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * V * (-Real.log alpha)) +
        (1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) * y +
          Real.exp 1 * strongMomentQScale q Q * (-Real.log alpha) / 3 +
        alpha⁻¹ * (Q / ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1)))

theorem hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_bernstein_confidence
    {Ω Z E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hindep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X μ)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ)
    (F : Z → Set E) (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z)) (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    {R : ℝ} (hFbound : ∀ z, ∀ y ∈ F z, ‖y‖ ≤ R)
    (v b : ℝ≥0) (hv : 0 < (v : ℝ))
    (hB₀ : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 →
      ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF
        (directionalSupportDeviation
          (fun i ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω)))
          (iidAumannTarget μ (X 0) F) w 0) v b μ)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {eps δ : ℝ}
    (heps : 0 < eps) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδone : δ ≤ 1) :
    μ.real {ω |
        (Real.sqrt (2 *
              (((∑ _i ∈ Finset.range n, v : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) *
                Real.log
                  (2 * (1 + 2 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E / δ)) +
            2 * (b : ℝ) *
              Real.log
                (2 * (1 + 2 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E / δ)) /
            (n : ℝ) + (R + R) * eps <
          hausdorffDist
            (closedConvexHull ℝ
              (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) (fun i => F (X i ω))))
            (iidAumannTarget μ (X 0) F)} ≤ δ

    (hindep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X μ)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ)
    (F : Z → Set E) (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z)) (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    {R : ℝ} (hFbound : ∀ z, ∀ y ∈ F z, ‖y‖ ≤ R)
    (v b : ℝ≥0) (hv : 0 < (v : ℝ))
    (hB₀ : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 →
      ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF
        (directionalSupportDeviation
          (fun i ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω)))
          (iidAumannTarget μ (X 0) F) w 0) v b μ)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {eps x : ℝ}
    (heps : 0 < eps) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    μ.real {ω |
        (Real.sqrt (2 *
              (((∑ _i ∈ Finset.range n, v : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) * x) +
            2 * (b : ℝ) * x) / (n : ℝ) + (R + R) * eps <
          hausdorffDist
            (closedConvexHull ℝ
              (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) (fun i => F (X i ω))))
            (iidAumannTarget μ (X 0) F)} ≤
      (1 + 2 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E * (2 * exp (-x))

    {I Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [MeasurableSpace C(T, ℝ)] [BorelSpace C(T, ℝ)]
    (mu : Measure Omega) [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (Y : I → Omega → C(T, ℝ))
    (hY : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (Y i) mu)
    (delta : ℕ → ℝ) (hdelta : ∀ k, 0 < delta k)
    (hcontrol : ∀ epsilon : ℝ, 0 < epsilon →
      ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧
        ∃ eta : ℕ → ℝ, Tendsto eta atTop (nhds 0) ∧
          ∀ i, mu.real {omega |
            B < ‖Y i omega‖ ∨
              ∃ k s t, dist s t < delta k ∧
                eta k < dist (Y i omega s) (Y i omega t)} ≤ epsilon) :
    IsTightMeasureSet (Set.range fun i ↦ mu.map (Y i))

name: ProbabilityTheory.centeredTruncatedEmpiricalContinuousMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem centeredTruncatedEmpiricalContinuousMap_apply
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (H : Z → E → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (X : ℕ → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hHmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t))
    (hHcont : ∀ z, Continuous (H z)) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (n : ℕ) (omega : Omega) (t : EuclideanUnitBall E) :
    centeredTruncatedEmpiricalContinuousMap (mu := mu)
        H R ha X hX hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip n omega t =
      centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess (mu := mu) H R
        (a * Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) (Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ X
        (Finset.range (n + 1)) 0 omega (t : E)

    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (hRL2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) 2 mu)
    (hRsecond : ∀ i, ∫ omega, R (X i omega) ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ K ^ 2)
    (hpathMeas : ∀ n, AEMeasurable
      (centeredTruncatedEmpiricalContinuousMap (mu := mu)
        H R ha X hX hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip n) mu) :

    (X : iota → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))

name: ProbabilityTheory.fukNagaev_explicit_allocation
statement:
theorem fukNagaev_explicit_allocation
    {A V u : ℝ} {q r : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0) (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (hA : 0 < A) (hV : 0 < V) (hu : 0 < u) (hu1 : u < 1) :
    let y := fukNagaevTruncationLevel q A u
    let t := fukNagaevDeviation r V y u
    A / y ^ q +
        (exp (-t ^ 2 / (8 * V)) +
          (r.factorial : ℝ) * (8 * y / t) ^ r) ≤ u

    (hpolynomial :
      3 * (r.factorial : ℝ) * (8 * y) ^ r ≤ u * t ^ r) :
    A / y ^ q +
        (exp (-t ^ 2 / (8 * V)) +

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_dimensional_psiOne
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_dimensional_psiOne
    {Ω Z E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hindep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X μ)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ)
    (F : Z → Set E) (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z)) (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    {R : ℝ} (hFbound : ∀ z, ∀ y ∈ F z, ‖y‖ ≤ R)
    (K : ℝ≥0)
    (hpsi₀ : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 →
      ProbabilityTheory.HasPsiOneNormBound
        (directionalSupportDeviation
          (fun i ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω)))
          (iidAumannTarget μ (X 0) F) w 0) K μ)
    (hcenter₀ : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 →
      μ[directionalSupportDeviation
          (fun i ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω)))
          (iidAumannTarget μ (X 0) F) w 0] = 0)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {eps x : ℝ}
    (heps : 0 < eps) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    μ.real {ω |
        (Real.sqrt (2 *
              (((∑ _i ∈ Finset.range n, (4 * K ^ 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) * x) +
            2 * (K : ℝ) * x) / (n : ℝ) + (R + R) * eps <
          hausdorffDist
            (closedConvexHull ℝ
              (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) (fun i => F (X i ω))))
            (iidAumannTarget μ (X 0) F)} ≤
      (1 + 2 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E * (2 * exp (-x))

statement:
theorem integral_densePrefixAbs_centeredEmpirical_le_rademacherGhost
    {OmegaData OmegaSign : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace OmegaData] [MeasurableSpace OmegaSign]
    {muData : Measure OmegaData} {muSign : Measure OmegaSign}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure muData] [IsProbabilityMeasure muSign]
    (n : ℕ) (k : ℕ)
    (epsilon : OmegaSign → Fin n → ℝ)
    (X : Fin n → OmegaData → EuclideanUnitBall E → ℝ)
    (hXmeas : ∀ i t, Measurable (fun x ↦ X i x t))
    (hXint : ∀ i t, Integrable (fun x ↦ X i x t) muData)
    (hXindep : iIndepFun (fun i x
      (j : Finset.range (k + 1)) ↦
        X i x (denseSeq (EuclideanUnitBall E) j)) muData)
    (hepsilon : ∀ eta i, epsilon eta i = 1 ∨ epsilon eta i = -1)
    (hCenteredInt : Integrable (fun x ↦
      densePrefixAbsSupremum
        (centeredEmpiricalLipschitzProcess muData n X x) k) muData)
    (hGhostInt : Integrable
      (fun p : OmegaData × OmegaData ↦
        finiteVectorSupAbs (Finset.range (k + 1))
          Finset.nonempty_range_add_one (fun j ↦
            ∑ i : Fin n, ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ *
              X i p.1 (denseSeq (EuclideanUnitBall E) j) -
              (n : ℝ)⁻¹ *
              X i p.2 (denseSeq (EuclideanUnitBall E) j))))
      (muData.prod muData))
    (hSignedJointInt : Integrable
      (fun z : (OmegaData × OmegaData) × OmegaSign ↦
        finiteVectorSupAbs (Finset.range (k + 1))
          Finset.nonempty_range_add_one (fun j ↦
            ∑ i : Fin n, epsilon z.2 i *
              ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ *
                X i z.1.1 (denseSeq (EuclideanUnitBall E) j) -
               (n : ℝ)⁻¹ *
                X i z.1.2 (denseSeq (EuclideanUnitBall E) j))))
      ((muData.prod muData).prod muSign))
    (hFullSignedJointInt : Integrable
      (fun z : (OmegaData × OmegaData) × OmegaSign ↦
        ⨆ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
          |rademacherGhostEmpiricalProcess n epsilon X z.1 z.2 t|)
      ((muData.prod muData).prod muSign))
    (hRbdd : ∀ p eta, BddAbove (Set.range fun t : EuclideanUnitBall E ↦
      |rademacherGhostEmpiricalProcess n epsilon X p eta t|)) :
    (∫ x, densePrefixAbsSupremum
        (centeredEmpiricalLipschitzProcess muData n X x) k ∂muData) ≤
      ∫ p, ∫ eta, (⨆ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
        |rademacherGhostEmpiricalProcess n epsilon X p eta t|)
        ∂muSign ∂(muData.prod muData)

    (hcompact : ∀ o, IsCompact (S o)) (hne : ∀ o, (S o).Nonempty)
    (phi : Theta → O × X → H)
    (hphiMeas : ∀ theta, Measurable (phi theta))
    (hphiCont : ∀ theta o, Continuous fun x ↦ phi theta (o, x))
    (g : Theta → O → ℝ) (hg : ∀ theta, Integrable (g theta) mu)
    (hdom : ∀ theta o, ∀ x ∈ S o, ‖phi theta (o, x)‖ ≤ g theta o) :
    kernelAttainableZeroSet mu S phi =
      setValuedZeroSet (aumannMomentMap mu S phi)

name: RandomSetTheory.mem_jointLawAttainableZeroSet_iff

theorem mem_jointLawAttainableZeroSet_iff

    theta ∈ jointLawAttainableZeroSet mu S phi ↔
      0 ∈ jointLawAttainableMoments mu S (phi theta)

name: ProbabilityTheory.tendsto_measure_failure_strictDomination_of_uniformApproximation
statement:
theorem tendsto_measure_failure_strictDomination_of_uniformApproximation
    {oracleCurvature oracleSignal actualCurvature actualSignal :
      Nat → Omega → Real}
    {curvatureError signalError : Nat → Real}
    {curvatureLimit signalLimit : Real}
    (hgap : curvatureLimit < signalLimit)
    (horacleCurvature : TendstoInMeasure probabilityMeasure oracleCurvature
      atTop (fun _ ↦ curvatureLimit))
    (horacleSignal : TendstoInMeasure probabilityMeasure oracleSignal
      atTop (fun _ ↦ signalLimit))
    (hcurvatureError : Tendsto curvatureError atTop (nhds 0))
    (hsignalError : Tendsto signalError atTop (nhds 0))
    (hactualCurvature : ∀ n omega,
      actualCurvature n omega ≤ oracleCurvature n omega + curvatureError n)
    (hactualSignal : ∀ n omega,
      oracleSignal n omega ≤ actualSignal n omega + signalError n) :
    Tendsto (fun n ↦ probabilityMeasure {omega |
      actualSignal n omega ≤ actualCurvature n omega})
      atTop (nhds 0)

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_enlarged_momentCorrespondence_le_of_uniformStrongMonotonicity
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_enlarged_momentCorrespondence_le_of_uniformStrongMonotonicity
    (Theta : Set E) [Nonempty P] {kappa Delta : ℝ}
    (g : P → Theta → E) (root : P → Theta)
    (hkappa : 0 < kappa) (hDelta : 0 ≤ Delta)
    (hmono : UniformStrongMonotonicity Theta kappa g)
    (hroot : ∀ p, g p (root p) = 0)
    (Ghat : Theta → Set E)
    (hfin : ∀ theta,
      hausdorffEDist (Ghat theta) (momentCorrespondence Theta g theta) ≠ ⊤)
    (hhaus : ∀ theta,
      hausdorffDist (Ghat theta) (momentCorrespondence Theta g theta) ≤ Delta) :
    hausdorffDist (enlargedSetValuedZeroSet Ghat Delta)
        (designatedRootSet Theta root) ≤ 2 * Delta / kappa

name: RandomSetTheory.infDist_momentCorrespondence_ge_designatedRootSet
